refnamediv.refpurpose: Sends data to a connected socket

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
socket
A Socket instance created with socket_create or socket_accept.
data
A buffer containing the data that will be sent to the remote host.
length
The maximum number of bytes that will be sent to the remote host from data. If it is greater than the length of data, it is silently reduced to it. It must not be negative.
flags
The value of flags can be any combination of the following flags, joined with the binary OR (|) operator.
Possible values for flags
MSG_OOB
Send OOB (out-of-band) data.
MSG_EOR
Indicate a record mark. The sent data completes the record.
MSG_EOF
Close the sender side of the socket and include an appropriate notification of this at the end of the sent data. The sent data completes the transaction. This is the meaning on BSD systems: on Linux the flag is accepted and has no effect.
MSG_DONTROUTE
Bypass routing, use direct interface.
MSG_DONTWAIT
Send without blocking, even on a blocking socket.
MSG_NOSIGNAL
Do not generate a SIGPIPE signal when the peer has closed the connection.
MSG_MORE
More data will follow, so the sending can be delayed.

&reftitle.errors;
If length is negative, a ValueError is thrown.
